correctness.rationale: For arbitrary unit Bloch vectors with nonzero sum, product-state covariance and exact transverse minimization give \((\Delta J_\perp)^2_{\min}=(1+c)/4\), where \(c=\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b\). With \(N=2\), direct substitution proves \(\xi_1=\sqrt{(1+c)/2}=\cos(\gamma/2)\) and \(\xi_2=1\). The antipodal zero-mean endpoint is excluded, and the checker independently reproduces representative cases and the source example.

value.rationale: The result gives a complete structural boundary for a standard squeezing diagnostic outside the symmetric sector: false positivity occurs for every nonidentical nonantipodal pure product state, can be arbitrarily strong in \(\xi_1\), and is simultaneously absent in \(\xi_2\). This sharpens an isolated example into an exact family-level statement with direct interpretive value.
